subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support deprecated `loadModelCatalog` compatibility semantics for external plugins, or formally move Plugin SDK consumers to the lifecycle-owned prepared catalog APIs?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a released SDK barrel and its legacy cache behavior; code review can establish the implementation shape but cannot choose the repository's long-term external-plugin compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve the lifecycle contract
options.body: Accept the prepared catalog APIs as the supported model-discovery contract and document the deprecated wrapper's bounded transition behavior.

options.title: Preserve stronger legacy semantics
options.body: Require the wrapper to retain prior request-time/cache behavior until a separately approved SDK deprecation window is complete.

recommendation.title: Approve the lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Accept the prepared catalog APIs as the supported model-discovery contract and document the deprecated wrapper's bounded transition behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch's lifecycle ownership and SDK compatibility facade were authored in this review cycle, making this the most direct routing candidate for the required policy decision.
